item.tib: sdeb sbyor gyi phreng ba'i bstod pa
item.coloph: 'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bstod pa bya dka' ba'i khyad par 'dug tshul gyi phreng ba/ mkhas pa chen po gnas brtan ye shes dpal bshes gnyen gyi mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /shu b+haM 'di yi yi ge bcu gnyis pa'i tshigs bcad bcu gcig pa ya mu na yar bcad/ shong ston lo tsA ba chen po rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur te 'phro la las pa las shong ston de nyid kyi rgyud pa'i slob ma dpang lo tsA ba dge slong dpal ldan blo gro brtan pas/ slob dpon shAkya rak+Shi ta yes mdzad pa'i 'grel pa la brten nas/ yongs su rdzogs par bsgyur cing zhus te gtan pa phab pa'o
